name: Honolulu
dek: Honolulu International Airport, WMO 91182, on Oʻahu.
paragraphs: The station is Honolulu International Airport, WMO 91182, height 2 m, position 21°19′26″N, 157°55′46″W. Maui has its own sheet with Kahului. No tipping or tap-water source was opened for US sheets on this pass.

The highest average high in the table is 31.5 °C, in August. The lowest average low is 19.3 °C, in January. The wettest month by the precipitation column is March, at 59.8 mm, and the driest is June, at 12.6 mm.

climate.caption: Station: Honolulu International Airport, WMO 91182.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3.
climate.sourceTitle: WMO climate normals 1991-2020, Honolulu International Airport (91182)

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type A and B, 120 V, 60 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows United States at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Section 291C-41 of the Hawaii Revised Statutes, on the Legislature's site, says that on all roadways of sufficient width a vehicle shall be driven on the right half of the roadway, with exceptions such as overtaking, obstructions, three-lane roads, and one-way roads.
driving.sourceTitle: Hawaii Revised Statutes 291C-41, Hawaii State Legislature

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the US Dollar, code USD, for the United States of America. It also lists US Dollar (Next day), code USN, a funds code, which is not printed as the currency.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab gives the United States 29 rows. Pacific/Honolulu is commented Hawaii. The other US rows are not collapsed into it.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.note: CBP's page for international visitors. It applies to travelers arriving from outside the United States. We do not restate a visa rule.
